title: Flush Buffer on Drop
goal: Extract owned field data inside a `Drop` implementation efficiently.
hints: Look at how `self.data` is accessed inside `drop(&mut self)`.
The `std::mem::take` function leaves an empty vector in place. It transfers ownership without cloning.
explanation: `std::mem::take(&mut self.data)` extracts the vector without cloning. It replaces `self.data` with an empty default vector. Moving `self.data` directly fails to compile because `drop` only has a mutable reference.
